title: VOUCH Agent Reputation
summary: Register an AI agent, let its operator publish scores, and let other wallets vouch for it once each.
what: VOUCH is an Anchor 0.31.1 registry where each AI agent wallet gets a reputation account. The registering authority writes reputation, on-chain, vouch and anomaly scores; other wallets leave one 1-5 vouch each; check_reputation logs a lookup event.
app_note: The page at /dapps/vouch/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/vouch-program. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique lab program.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/vouch/, switch to Devnet, connect a wallet and call vouch_for on the lab agent from your own wallet.
try_steps.see: total_vouches on agent 4epEDZoA… goes up by one; a second vouch from the same wallet fails.

diagram: authority --register_agent--> agent PDA; authority --update_score--> scores; voucher --vouch_for--> vouch PDA (+1 total_vouches); anyone --check_reputation--> event
innovation: A cheap, readable trust record for agents: an off-chain scorer publishes scores on-chain, and peer vouches are capped at one per wallet by PDA seeds.
exercises: What stops a wallet from vouching twice, and what does not stop sybil vouching?
Who can change reputation_score, and how would you make it trustless?
not_covered: Off-chain scoring service from the upstream repo
